product.title: Mariposa Grove of Giant Sequoias and Wawona Small Group Tour

description.text: Walk among the world's largest trees on a small-group tour of Mariposa Grove near Wawona. Your naturalist guide leads the grove trails past the Grizzly Giant and California Tunnel Tree with commentary on sequoia ecology and Yosemite's southern history.

highlights: See the Grizzly Giant and California Tunnel Tree

start.description: Meet at the Mariposa Grove arrival area. Arrive 15 minutes before departure.

end.description: Return to the Mariposa Grove meeting point after the tour.

product.itinerarySummary: Walk among the world's largest trees on a small-group tour of Mariposa Grove near Wawona.

itineraryItems.title: Mariposa Grove

itineraryItems.title: Wawona
itineraryItems.description: Brief stop in the historic Wawona area with guide commentary on early park history.
